synopsis: ISO 19014-1 provides Machine Control System Safety Analysis (MCSSA) to identify safety-related control-system parts and determine the required Machine Performance Level (MPLr); it requires hazard and risk analysis and MPLr assignment [f2314, f2690]. For brake-commanding collision avoidance, this includes analysing erroneous or missing braking, with MPLr assigned using Part 1 or Part 5 tables; those tables derive from the Part 1 method [f2336, f2333]. Edition 2's FDIS was registered on 5 February 2026, voting closed on 22 August, and it remained under publication as of 1 October, scheduled for October 2026; the published catalogue edition was still the 2018 edition, marked “to be revised” [f2316, f2315]. Publication dates need reconciliation: Chapter 10 lists 22 November 2026 for revised ISO 19014-1, while Chapter 13 attaches that date specifically to FprEN ISO 19014-1, suggesting a possible ISO-versus-European-adoption distinction [f7738, f11219, f15179]. The booklet recommends an immediate gap analysis against revised Parts 1 and 4, but acknowledges that the final series texts were unavailable for review, leaving their final content uncertain [f10541, f2862].
